title: Research consolidation: portable R715 cancellation and frame-cost replay (no new kappa)
body:
The archived R715 cancellation result could only be replayed through scripts naming an old local workspace. This **research consolidation / independent finite verification** finds four retained files matching the exact parent SHA256 and supplies an offline, standard-library checker for the historical 20-pair deletion. It does not claim a new construction or kappa.

The checker reproduces **15,014 → 14,974 additions**, verifies all **955 abstract input columns** in both scalar directions, and independently derives the unchanged **4,140-child** local profile. It also accounts for **425 empty-source frame visits** removed by the old flattening step: every complete register frame itinerary agrees. A legal scalar-preserving control shows why this matters: splitting one climb with an empty record raises the count to 4,141 while preserving the binary map and rank mass.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/r715-cancellation-reconciliation/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/r715-cancellation-reconciliation/test_package.py
```

Expected: `PASS_R715_CANCELLATION_RECONCILIATION aliases=4 pairs=20 ADDs=15014->14974 columns=955 profile=unchanged`, followed by 15 passing tests. CPython 3.14.6 and 3.9.6 agree. Validation includes an independent Fraction oracle for all 963 frames, 16 rejection mutations, isolated relocated replay, byte-identical receipt regeneration, exact base/source pins, selected-record integrity and its five tests. A focused Linux workflow is included; no hosted pass is claimed at submission.

Base: `2921874911956718fcaaaf9396fe8267b3cfa9f0`; OS assignment seed **96**. Sources and context pins, exact coverage, proof and limitations are in the package README. Original discovery/native receipts and the selected frontier remain unchanged. No new native, physical/global supplier, precision, outer assembly or full theorem verification is claimed. The 39-million-comparison historical search was not repeated.

Credit remains with Rohan Arun's cancellation/archive work, Chafik Boukhalfa's R715/frame engine and their predecessors. Douglas Colkitt's original archive-integration scope is preserved. Concurrent Hanson Sun PR1024 reconciles a different R714/954-input word; this contributes the R715 deletion and empty-frame accounting evidence and imports none of that pending code. Related Sagar Thakrar PR719 concerns rational CK pairs.

Prepared for Ross Richardson (@RossRichardson) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, under Apache-2.0. No pinned coordination issue exists; the claim and final overlap checks are local.
